lis.profile: Lis — a cool, deadpan, ironic street narrator of an adult comedy show about used-car flippers. Low calm voice, dry humor, confident.
lis.notes: Part 13 of a comedy mini-series about Tolyan, a student car flipper. Dry ironic narrator; on «Очень сильно пахнет ёлочкой» — slow, deadpan. Numbers said fully.

tolyan.profile: Tolyan — a cocky Russian used-car flipper (perekup) in his 30s, street swagger, deep raspy voice, show-off, calls everyone «брат». Adult street comedy.
tolyan.notes: Line 1: calm, suspicious, interrogating. Line 2: amused, sarcastic, catching a liar.

zhora.profile: Zhora — a brash, cocky veteran Russian used-car flipper in his 50s, leather jacket, mustache, gold chain; loud, fast, mocking, calls the young rival «студент». Adult street comedy.
zhora.notes: Line 1: excited, greedy. Line 2: tired, joking, wiser now.

vitalik.profile: Vitalik — a slick, fast-talking Russian tuning-garage guy in his 30s, a bit of a con man.
vitalik.notes: Line 1: smooth, over-friendly pitch («по-братски», «мамой клянусь»). Line 2: too fast, too loud — obviously lying: «Не топлёная!»

misha.profile: Uncle Misha — a calm, kind Russian village pensioner in his 60s, a fisherman.
